language-recovery.restart.in_progress.me.text:
Restarting EyeCtrl…
Waiting for the new EyeCtrl to start. If it cannot, this one keeps running.
Hiding this notice does not stop the restart.

language-recovery.supervisor.waiting.text: The language is waiting for EyeCtrl.

overlays.subpixel.ask_title.text: Continue to the live-gaze part now?

overlays.subpixel.caption.text: Test picture — nothing here is clickable

overlays.subpixel.demo_hint.text: Demo — watch the ring's line, not its middle.

overlays.subpixel.intro_body.text: Look at Start to begin. At each question, look at 1 or 2 until it fills. To leave at any time, look at End test, or close your eyes for 10 seconds.

overlays.subpixel.result_acquitted.text: Sub-pixel placement is not reliably visible.

overlays.subpixel.result_incomplete.text: The test was incomplete — no verdict.

overlays.subpixel.static_can_tell.text: Still rings: you could tell them apart.

overlays.subpixel.static_cannot_tell.text: Still rings: you could not tell them apart.

overlays.subpixel.void_hold_body.text: The test continues by itself as soon as your gaze is back.

settings.diagnostics.subpixel.descriptio.text: Runs a short full-screen A/B test of the cursor ring's sub-pixel placement. Your settings and keyboard come back when it ends.

settings.diagnostics.subpixel.reason.ada.text: Turn adaptation off first; it can open its own window.

settings.diagnostics.subpixel.reason.eye.text: Turn eye care off first; it can open its own window.

settings.diagnostics.subpixel.reason.men.text: Close the modes menu, the task switcher and the quick-actions grid first.

settings.diagnostics.subpixel.reason.pau.text: Resume first, then start the test.

settings.diagnostics.subpixel.reason.run.text: A sub-pixel test is already running.

settings.diagnostics.subpixel.reason.sta.text: Leave dragging, scrolling or repeat mode first.

supervisor.setup.logon.saved-off.text: Saved: EyeCtrl will not start at logon.

supervisor.setup.logon.saved-on.text: Saved: EyeCtrl will start at logon.

supervisor.setup.logon.sending.text: Asking EyeCtrl to save the logon setting…

supervisor.setup.logon.superseded.text: The logon setting was changed in EyeCtrl meanwhile. That newer value stays.

supervisor.setup.logon.waiting.text: The logon setting is waiting for EyeCtrl.

_meta.pluralRules: A plural key's count is the first numeric argument. The 'one' form is chosen only when that count, formatted with the placeholder's own specifier and the provider of the language actually rendered, reads as the integer 1: 1.0 under {0} is one; 1.0 under {0:0.0} is other. Keys starting with an underscore are reserved meta notes and are never resolved.
